verdict.rationale: Greenhouse documents one native bulk capability: bulk outreach campaigns that reach many candidates at scale. The API supports advancing, moving and rejecting applications, but nothing shows these can be run in bulk across many items at once. missing for 10: general bulk actions on applications and candidates (bulk move, reject, edit), a documented bulk or batch API endpoint, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
